note: Perry County, OH has no public zoning district layer. Its engineer GIS downloads (addresses, parcels, roads, townships) and auditor Schneider viewer contain no zoning. Ohio townships, not the county, zone most land. New Lexington (county seat) codifies its zoning in Chapter 1125, but its Official Zoning District Map is kept on file at the Municipal Building, with no GIS or ArcGIS service found. No other Perry County city or village zoning service was found.
